subtitle.zh: 让灵感有条理，让故事有节奏。
subtitle.en: A little structure. A better story.

description.zh: 把想法整理成分镜，逐张打磨脚本、画面和节奏。在全片总览中看清故事的顺序，再切换聚焦阅读，专心预演下一条视频。
description.en: Turn an idea into scenes, refine the script and visual direction, then review the whole story. Switch to focus reading when it is time to rehearse.

coverAlt.zh: 实际运行的视频策划应用，展示分镜卡片与脚本
coverAlt.en: The live Video Planner app with storyboard scenes and a script

zh: 用分镜卡片整理故事顺序，逐张修改脚本与拍摄说明。
把参考图片与留言放在对应的分镜里。
查看全片节奏，再切换聚焦阅读进行预演。
en: Arrange scenes and refine the script and visual direction for each one.
Keep reference images and production notes with the right scene.
Review the overall pacing, then rehearse in focus reading.

description.zh: 所有策划集中在一起，从一个故事开始。
description.en: Your plans in one place. Choose a story to begin.

description.zh: 拖动分镜安排顺序，在同一张卡片里修改脚本和拍摄备注。
description.en: Arrange scenes, refine the script and keep production notes together.

description.zh: 从开场到收尾，看清整条视频的顺序与节奏。
description.en: See the running order and pacing from the hook to the final scene.

description.zh: 一次只看当前一幕，保留右侧 Agent 对话，随时继续打磨。
description.en: Rehearse one scene at a time, with Agent Chat still by your side.

description.zh: 应用与助手在同一个 Work 中，围绕同一个故事继续工作。
description.en: Keep the app and the conversation in the same Work, ready for your next idea.

description.zh: 把工作放进待办、进行中和已完成。按项目与标签聚焦任务，在详情里保留讨论，用甘特图安排开始与截止日期。
description.en: Move work through To do, In progress and Done. Focus by project or label, keep discussion on each task, and plan start and due dates in Timeline.

coverAlt.zh: 实际运行的看板应用，展示发布项目的三列任务
coverAlt.en: The live Kanban app with three columns of launch tasks

zh: 拖动任务卡片，在待办、进行中和已完成之间推进。
用项目、标签和搜索聚焦当前工作。
在甘特图中调整任务日期，在详情留言区记录讨论。
en: Drag task cards between To do, In progress and Done.
Focus your work with projects, labels and search.
Adjust dates in Timeline and keep discussion in task notes.

description.zh: 三列状态、一份清晰的任务进度，拖动卡片即可推进工作。
description.en: Three columns and one clear view of progress. Drag a card to move work forward.

description.zh: 选择 Piwork 发布项目，专注这一轮要完成的任务。
description.en: Select the Piwork launch project to focus on the work for this release.

description.zh: 描述、优先级、日期、标签和讨论，都留在任务上。
description.en: Keep the description, priority, dates, labels and discussion attached to the task.

description.zh: 查看任务的起止时间，拖动色条调整排期。
description.en: Review start and due dates, then drag task bars to adjust the schedule.

description.zh: 按设计、调研等标签筛选，把注意力放在当前这类工作上。
description.en: Filter by Design, Research or another label to focus on related work.

subtitle.en: A few pixels. A little personality.

description.zh: 从十张变体中挑选喜欢的样子，再调整视角、造型与配色。把作品保存在系列画廊，下载清晰的 PNG 或整组组图，继续做出自己的像素角色。
description.en: Find a favorite among ten variations, then make the look and colors your own. Keep your characters in collections and take them with you as crisp PNGs or contact sheets.

coverAlt.zh: 实际运行的头像工坊，展示同一像素角色的十张造型变体
coverAlt.en: The live Avatar Studio app showing ten variations of a pixel character

zh: 并排比较十张变体，切换正面、侧脸与站立视角。
调整发型、上衣、眼镜、表情、描边与五种配色。
管理五组共 43 张示例头像，下载单张 PNG 或系列组图。
en: Compare ten variations with front, profile, and full-body views.
Customize hair, outfits, glasses, expressions, outlines, and five colors.
Explore 43 example avatars in five collections, then download PNGs or contact sheets.

description.zh: 从同一角色的十种变化开始，并排比较不同造型。
description.en: Start with ten variations of one character and compare looks side by side.

description.zh: 修改视角、造型和五种配色，预览随操作实时变化。
description.en: Fine-tune the view, look, and five colors with a live preview.

description.zh: 把喜欢的造型存下来，继续编辑或下载整组。
description.en: Keep your favorites together, ready to edit or download as a contact sheet.

description.zh: 正面、侧脸和站立视角，让同一角色拥有更多表达。
description.en: Explore front, profile, and full-body views of the same character.

description.zh: 在同一个 Work 中描述下一组想法，继续和 Agent 协作。
description.en: Describe the next collection in the same Work and keep creating with the Agent.
